written: before any V144 table, F144 / V-type / bootstrap preflop solve, or A4R evaluation exists; at this time node 28 has 25/72 new flops; only identity validations have been run (review/F72_identity: M14_72 = A3 used14 bit-exact, g(M14_72) = P15 exact, cross-eval self-consistency exact)
basis: docs/GTO_TERMINAL_A4B_A4R_DESIGN_REVIEW_V2.md (ed44d5d) + the user's corrections of 2026-10-01 (paired nested bootstrap; EV difference as the primary A4R value), each re-checked before adoption (section 'review_of_corrections')

primary.quantity: D = g(V144) - g(V72) per main aggregate; V = measured continuation tables at the P14 ranges (V72 = outer_m28_6/k14/node{n}/table_measured.json; V144 = aggregate.py on panel_v3_144 with the 72 k14 + 72 new flops); g = one frozen-table preflop solve (A3 config, seeds, 400 iterations), both terminals together
primary.bootstrap: nested paired: per stratum, old = its 6 panel_v2_72 boards, new = its 6 extension boards; replicate r resamples old and new separately with replacement (seed 20261001, old then new per stratum in sorted stratum order); V72*_r from old*_r only, V144*_r from old*_r + new*_r; D*_r = g(V144*_r) - g(V72*_r)
primary.replicates: 60 (raised from 30 before any result: the 95% quantile of a max-statistic over 30 replicates is the 2nd-largest value; cost 120 preflop solves, about 2.2 h)
primary.report: point D; mean(D*), SD(D*), percentile 95% interval of D*; bootstrap bias estimate mean(D*) - D and bias-corrected 2D - mean(D*) (secondary; the table->policy map is non-linear and its bias scales with table variance, A4)
primary.simultaneous: m = aggregates with SD(D*) > 1e-4; T*_r = max_a |D*_ra - mean_a(D*)| / SD_a(D*); c = 95% quantile of T*; simultaneous band D_a +/- c SD_a; a panel-detectable shift exists if some |D_a| > c SD_a. Bonferroni z = Phi^-1(1 - 0.05/(2m)) reported alongside
primary.limitation: the panel was drawn without replacement proportional to raw-flop counts; the bootstrap resamples with replacement and equal weight within the old / new groups: approximate

secondary_A3_process.quantity: g(M14_144) - P15, M14_144 = A3 k14 rule (0.5 V144 + 0.5 M13, guard 0.05 bb at P14 ranges, fallback measured) - point only, reported separately, never merged into the primary reading
secondary_A3_process.staleness: g(V72) - P15 (damping / non-convergence component), point only

superseded: the h72 consistency reading of prereg.json (replaced by the paired max-statistic band)

A4R.primary: dEV_p(A -> G) = EV_p(sigma_G; G) - EV_p(A_p (+) sigma_G,-p; G): seat p swapped to policy A's strategy blocks, all other seats held at G's own solve sigma_G, EV from the preflop solver's average-strategy EVs (bb per hand); positive_loss = max(dEV, 0) also recorded
A4R.groups: per seat (CO, BTN, SB, BB) and per terminal-relevant group: SB (all SB nodes), BB|SB-open (BB nodes in the subtree below node 4, path BB@4, node 6 side), BTN (all BTN nodes), BB|BTN-open (BB nodes in the subtree below node 26, path BB@26, node 28 side); a partial splice is still an exact EV difference against identical opponents
A4R.games_and_policies: points: G72 = V72 tables with sigma72 = g(V72); G144 = V144 with sigma144 = g(V144). Paired bootstrap: G72*_r / G144*_r with their own solves, swaps within the same replicate r
validation: self-splice (A = sigma_G): dEV = 0 exactly and the save is byte-identical
BR value BR_p = EV_p + gap_p identical (|d| <= 1e-12) before and after any splice of seat p
splicing every seat from A reproduces the full-profile cross-eval of A exactly
A4R.also_reported: raw NashConv of A and of sigma_G in G (no subtraction); reach-weighted class-level L1 distance of A vs sigma_G at the SB first-in, BB@4, BTN first-in and BB@26 nodes
A4R.scales_not_thresholds: per group: own residual gap_p(sigma_G), positive_loss, B_post = 0.0076 bb/hand (postflop exploitability contribution of nodes 6 + 28; a different error source, never added); ratios may be reported, none is a pass line
A4R.withdrawn: the 0.005 / 0.02 bb/hand thresholds and the ROBUST / BORDERLINE / NOT_ROBUST classes of a4r_robust/prereg.json, and its gap_total-difference metric
A4R.limitation: frozen-table game at the P14 ranges: range-dependence of the continuation values under a changed policy is not measured

definitions.floor_p: own residual gap_p(sigma_G) of the baseline solve (per game)
definitions.EV_stable: for every group: point positive_loss <= floor_p (both directions) AND 95% quantile over paired replicates of positive_loss <= the replicate's floor_p
definitions.EV_sensitive: some group: point positive_loss > floor_p AND its paired-bootstrap 95% quantile > floor_p
definitions.frequency_unstable: a panel-detectable shift (simultaneous band) OR some main-aggregate bootstrap 95% half-width of g(V144*) > 0.005 (the A3 research criterion, used only to describe frequency precision)

labels.inconclusive: any validation fails, or < 90% of replicates usable

final_classification_fixed_before_result.wording: 'smaller / larger than the residual suboptimality of the baseline preflop solve', not 'detectability floor'
final_classification_fixed_before_result.no_production_verdict: no production PASS/FAIL; 288 is only proposed with its cost, never started

review_of_corrections.paired_nested_bootstrap: adopted: it keeps the old-panel covariance that sd144 only approximates under iid. Added: D* is centred near D, not 0, so the band uses centred D* (max-statistic of |D* - mean| / SD); bias term reported separately; 60 replicates for the max-statistic tail
review_of_corrections.EV_primary: adopted: EV difference is the definition, gap difference the validation. Added: BR-value identity check, lower bound -gap_p(sigma_G), sub-seat groups (a seat-level BB swap mixes node-6 and node-28 decisions)
review_of_corrections.added_label: 'stable at 144 in frequency and EV' added so every outcome has a label
